about: The raid tester (RaidTester.kt): a playtesting helper for The Fractured Archive, testing only and not live content, so nothing here is from the Wiki. He is the cache's Leagues Tutor (league_tutor_normal, 316), which no live world shows outside a league. Both tiles are ours.

spawns.source: Ours: Lumbridge's courtyard, three tiles east of the spawn (3222,3218), facing it
Ours: the raid's lobby, south-east of the tile in front of the Archive Door (4127,5560), to kit out again after a wipe
